rulings.restated: Enter the amount from helper "Form 1040 line 11b adjusted gross income, but not less than zero".
rulings.model: The form says 'Enter amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b' and gives no floor. The program enters zero when AGI is negative, so the printed line 2 differs whenever line 11b is below zero.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: genuine ambiguity; project retained (amb.2025.sa_medical_negative_agi). The printed line 2 says "Enter amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b" and the form gives no floor, as the model says (f1040sa p. 1). With line 11b below zero the printed arithmetic makes line 3 ("Multiply line 2 by 7.5% (0.075)") negative and line 4 ("Subtract line 3 from line 1. If line 3 is more than line 1, enter -0-") larger than line 1: a deduction of medical expenses that were not paid. The instruction allows "only the part of your medical and dental expenses that exceeds 7.5% of the amount of your adjusted gross income on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b" (i1040sca p. 1, Medical and Dental Expenses), and no part of the expenses exceeds the expenses themselves; the project therefore enters line 11b on line 2 at no less than zero, which leaves lines 3 and 4 as printed. Tax-Calculator and PolicyEngine-US floor adjusted gross income at zero before the percentage (BUG-0094). The helper that floors it is named on line 2 and the glossary states the floor; the difference from the printed line is confined to a negative line 11b.
